headline: Google's Pet Memory forgot who my cats are
summary: User tests Google's new Pet Memory feature for Gemini for Home. The feature aims to reduce notification overload from pet cameras. However, it surprisingly failed to recognize the user's own cats.

headline: The Verge Guide to Pets
summary: Technology offers numerous solutions for pet ownership, from feeding to entertainment. High-tech gadgets aim to simplify caring for pets. Many owners invest significantly in pet tech, believing nothing is too good for their animals.

headline: My parrot ate my keyboard
summary: Pets bring immense joy, unconditional love, and emotional fulfillment to life. The article highlights the unique bond between humans and their animal companions. It recounts a humorous incident where the author's parrot damaged their keyboard.

headline: Oops! My cat is an iPad kid
summary: Pet ownership entails responsibilities like keeping animals happy and mentally stimulated. The author, working from home, provides ample play for their cat Trevor. Younger cats, however, often require additional stimulation, sometimes found in unexpected places like an iPad.

headline: Drakong's New Attack on Titan-Themed Collectible Controllers Come In a Blind Box
summary: Drakong is releasing new keychain-sized controllers inspired by Attack on Titan. These pixelated NES-style controllers feature various AOT characters. They will be sold in blind boxes, adding an element of surprise for collectors.

headline: 'No Disc No Buy' Comments Dominate Sony's Phantom Blade Zero State of Play Livestream, as Planned PlayStation Boycott Nears
summary: Sony's Phantom Blade Zero livestream was overwhelmed by "No Disc No Buy" comments. Fans expressed strong opposition to digital-only game trends. A planned PlayStation boycott over physical media concerns appears to be gaining traction.

headline: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is 'Reimagining' The Series' Original Game With a Focus Meter, Skill Tree and Herb Brewing
summary: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis will reimagine the series' first game. The title introduces RPG-like elements, including a skill tree and herb brewing. A new chargeable focus meter will also be integrated into gameplay.

headline: Do Not Boycott GTA 6, Fired Rockstar Workers Tell Fans: 'There's a Better Way to Support Us and Hold Rockstar to Account'
summary: Fired Rockstar workers involved in a legal dispute have urged fans not to boycott GTA 6. They believe boycotting is not the best way to support them. Workers suggest alternative methods to hold Rockstar accountable.

headline: UK 'supports Ukraine 100%', Burnham says, after Russia's drone warning
summary: Russia accused the UK of escalating the Ukraine war by supplying British-made drones. Prime Minister vows to support Kyiv in its "hour of need." The UK reaffirms its full support for Ukraine.

headline: British couple on honeymoon killed in helicopter crash on Greek island
summary: A British newlywed couple, Alexander Cromie and Marie Ebert, died in a helicopter crash. The incident occurred on a Greek island during their honeymoon. Their Greek pilot was also killed in the crash.

headline: IVF staff accused of misleading UK parents about sperm and egg donors in northern Cyprus
summary: IVF staff in northern Cyprus are accused of misleading UK parents. Multiple children are feared to have been conceived using unselected donors. Parents may have received different sperm and egg donors than chosen.

headline: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
summary: German authorities conducted raids targeting human smuggling gangs. They seized dinghies and life jackets from a secret police warehouse. This action is part of a new law cracking down on illegal smuggling operations.
